lessons.title: Hear and form /i/, /y/, and /u/
lessons.objective: Distinguish the three French high vowels in words and short requests, with /y/ made by rounding the lips while the tongue stays forward.
lessons.focus: Compare si /si/, su /sy/, and sous /su/. Keep the tongue forward for /i/ and /y/; round the lips for /y/. Move the tongue back for /u/.

lessons.title: Keep /m/ steady as the vowel changes
lessons.objective: Move from /mi/ through /my/ to /mu/ without replacing the French vowels with English ones.
lessons.focus: Start each syllable with the same closed-lip /m/. Compare mie /mi/, mu /my/, and mou /mu/; the lip and tongue position changes after /m/.

lessons.title: Release /p/ briefly in French words
lessons.objective: Produce a brief French /p/ release in common words and requests, and keep the following vowel clear.
lessons.focus: Compare pain, prix, porte, and pomme. Close both lips for /p/, then release into the next vowel without a strong English-style puff of air.
